Hilt frame.description: The metal frame follows the grip and extends over the blade base. Its surface carries the transition between the broad blade and the paired grip scales.

sources.title: The Met · Yatagan with Scabbard, dated 1802–3, 32.75.261a, b

Left grip scale.description: One of the two shaped scales around the hilt. Its flared rear edge forms one of the yatagan’s distinctive ears.

sources.title: The Met · Yatagan with Scabbard, dated 1802–3, 32.75.261a, b

Right grip scale.description: The opposite scale completes the handhold. Separate it to compare the matching shape and the space enclosed between the two plaques.

Ornamental studs.description: Small circular ornaments appear on both faces near the blade base. They are separate surfaces in this model and move together as a group.
